description: This file defines the Node class for a tree view widget in the Yahoo! UI library, including methods for node manipulation, rendering, and dynamic loading.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a tree view widget, with methods for expansion, collapse, rendering, and dynamic data loading.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with data, parent, and expansion state.

methods.name: appendChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node.

methods.name: getSiblings
methods.description: Returns sibling nodes.

methods.name: showChildren
methods.description: Displays child nodes.

methods.name: hideChildren
methods.description: Hides child nodes.

methods.name: getElId
methods.description: Returns the DOM element ID for this node.

methods.name: getChildrenElId
methods.description: Returns the DOM element ID for the children container.

methods.name: getToggleElId
methods.description: Returns the DOM element ID for the toggle icon.

methods.name: getEl
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element for this node.

methods.name: getChildrenEl
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element for the children container.

methods.name: getToggleEl
methods.description: Retrieves the toggle icon DOM element.

methods.name: getToggleLink
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code to toggle this node.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses this node.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands this node.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the node based on its state.

methods.name: getHoverStyle
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for hover state.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Recursively expands all child nodes.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Recursively collapses all child nodes.

methods.name: setDynamicLoad
methods.description: Sets a data loader function for dynamic loading.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if this node is the root node.

methods.name: isDynamic
methods.description: Determines if the node loads data dynamically.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Checks if the node has children, considering lazy load.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between expanded and collapsed states.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Returns HTML representation of the node.

methods.name: getChildrenHtml
methods.description: Returns HTML for the children container.

methods.name: renderChildren
methods.description: Renders child nodes, handling dynamic loading if needed.

methods.name: completeRender
methods.description: Completes rendering of child nodes.

methods.name: loadComplete
methods.description: Callback after dynamic data load completes.

methods.name: getAncestor
methods.description: Returns ancestor node at specified depth.

methods.name: getDepthStyle
methods.description: Returns CSS class based on node depth.

methods.name: getNodeHtml
methods.description: Returns HTML for the node.
